beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The conversation method provides a practical entry into its political and institutional questions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Later sections broaden the challenge from speaking responsibly to designing power that remains answerable.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book offers a demanding perspective to examine, not guaranteed agreement across every conflict.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it to connect honest conversation with the institutions that let disagreement remain survivable.
